what_it_is.prose: NSIL is the commercial arm of ISRO and India's space-launch-and-satellite services PSU, incorporated in 2019 to assume responsibility for production, assembly and integration of launch vehicles (PSLV, SSLV, LVM3) through industry consortium, and to operate ISRO's demand-driven communication satellites (GSAT-24 leased to Tata Play, GSAT-N2 launched by SpaceX Nov 2024). NSIL executed the first dedicated commercial launch of LVM3 (OneWeb India-1, Oct 23, 2022, 36 satellites) and the LVM3-M3 / OneWeb India-2 mission (Mar 26, 2023, 36 satellites) — completing the 72-satellite OneWeb contract worth ₹1,000+ Cr. NSIL reported ₹3,026.09 Cr revenue (FY). Till date NSIL has launched 124 international and 3 Indian customer satellites onboard PSLV, LVM3 and SSLV. NSIL awarded a $104M contract to an industry consortium for PSLV production.

rows.india_status: India's heaviest rocket. First dedicated commercial launch (LVM3-M2 / OneWeb India-1) on Oct 23, 2022 carried 36 OneWeb satellites; LVM3-M3 / OneWeb India-2 (Mar 26, 2023) carried 36 more. Sixth operational LVM3 flight launched BlueBird Block-2 communication satellite Dec 29, 2025

rows.platform_or_product: PSLV (Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle) — industry consortium production
rows.india_status: NSIL is the nodal agency for PSLV production through Indian industry consortium ($104M contract awarded Sep 2020 to HAL/L&T consortium). Till date NSIL has launched 124 international + 3 Indian customer satellites onboard PSLV, LVM3 and SSLV
First demand-driven communication satellite mission undertaken by NSIL; full capacity leased to Tata Play. Launched on Ariane-5 (Jun 2022)
Second demand-driven communication satellite owned and operated by NSIL; built by ISRO. Provides 48 Gbps capacity covering all of India. Launched by SpaceX Falcon 9 Nov 2024

rows.context: LVM3-M2 / OneWeb India-1: 36 satellites launched Oct 23, 2022 — first dedicated commercial LVM3 launch via NSIL. LVM3-M3 / OneWeb India-2: 36 more satellites launched Mar 26, 2023. Total 72 satellites for ₹1,000+ Cr contract
GSAT-24 / GSAT-N1 — full satellite capacity leased to Tata Play (launched Ariane-5, Jun 2022)
GSAT-N2 / GSAT-20 Ka-band broadband satellite — launched by SpaceX Falcon 9
Sixth operational LVM3 flight launched BlueBird Block-2 communication satellite (Dec 29, 2025) — NSIL's 3rd dedicated commercial LVM3 launch
